title: The batch runner's working state lives in one file on branch roadmap that it rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction
why: Owner 22:47 CST Nov 13 (relayed): the batch runner seemed to have amnesia after compaction. Third cause, by the consultant: its working state (merge queue order, train batches and members, gos, holds with their end events, archive pass) lives only in its handoff.
note: Triage 22:48 CST Nov 13: one file on branch roadmap (the wave plan or a sibling file) that the runner rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction; its handoff points to the file and never copies the list (handoff prompt step 4: "name the home and never copy the list"). Open problem, runner 10's own words earlier tonight (relayed): it cannot push to the record branch. Options for the lane to weigh: the runner sends the state to triage, who commits it (a per-merge message); or the runner is given push access to roadmap by its own grant. Neither is chosen. Not started; the coordinator assigns a lane. Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read first. Coordinator 22:59 CST (relayed): lane session_013NEJKzngb7eVxWuaoEuzrC started. Its pick for the push problem (coordinator's, not the owner's): no new grant; runner 10 sends its state to triage per merge and triage commits; schema and seed file in the lane's PR. The lane stops and reports if a past ruling contradicts it. Lane session_013NEJKzngb7eVxWuaoEuzrC 23:37 CST Nov 13 (relayed): PR #3359 (draft, head 4d6fb4dac0, lane lint PASS) builds the runner-state route; record docs/decisions/runner-state-on-record.md. TRIAGE DUTY after #3359 merges: commit the seed skills/project-ops/templates/runner-state.json to roadmap as plans/runner-state.json (repo and runner filled, version 0). Then on each message from runner 10 whose first line is `RUNNER-STATE <owner/repo> v<N> after merge #<PR>`: save the body to a file, run python3 skills/project-ops/scripts/check_runner_state.py message <file>, commit the body whole as plans/runner-state.json, reply with the commit; refuse and say why if the check prints a problem.
